featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Iteeha, and I must say, it was a truly delightful experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warmth and a cozy ambiance that immediately made me feel at home. Here's my review of this wonderful café:

Atmosphere (5/5):
The café exudes a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. The soft lighting, comfortable seating, and tasteful decor create the perfect setting for a leisurely coffee or meal. Whether you're looking for a quiet spot to read a book or catch up with friends, this café has the perfect ambiance for any occasion.

Service (5/5):
The staff at the are exceptional. They are not only friendly but also incredibly attentive. My order was taken promptly, and my coffee arrived in no time. I appreciate the staff's willingness to offer recommendations from their menu and their willingness to accommodate special requests.

Coffee and Beverages (5/5):
The café takes its coffee seriously, and it shows. My cortado was expertly crafted, with a rich and robust flavor. They offer a variety of coffee options, and I was impressed by the quality of their beans. Additionally, their selection of teas and other beverages caters to a wide range of tastes.

Price (4/5):
The prices at Iteeha are reasonable for the quality of food and service offered. While it might not be the cheapest option in town, the value you receive is well worth it. Plus, the generous portions make it easy to share or take home leftovers.

Conclusion:
Iteeha is a gem in the world of cafes. Its inviting atmosphere, excellent service, and top-notch coffee and desserts make it a must-visit for anyone looking for a cozy place to unwind or meet with friends. I can't wait to return and explore more of their menu. Highly recommended!

name: Chanakya School of Craft
description:
The vision of The Chanakya Foundation focusses on cultural sustainability and all-round
development through education, skill development and women’s empowerment while
investing in the preservation of our heritage and promotion of the arts.

Our mission is to provide women from low income communities with high-quality education
in hand embroidery, enabling them to maximize their potential and enhance their lives.

The Foundation believes in transforming societies by instilling a vision, making role
models and promoting a sense of community.
